newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF to supply bearings to Toyota.
newsitem.headline: SKF to supply bearings to Toyota.

text.p: Swedish rollerbearing maker AB SKF said on Thursday it signed a contract to supply wheel bearings to Japan's Toyota Motor Corporation.
"SKF has signed a contract to make direct deliveries to Toyota's domestic car production units," SKF said in a statement.
SKF said Toyota chose its Hub Unit 1 product for the front wheel of Toyota's new Multi Purpose Vehicle (MPV) model. The model is known as the Ipsum in Japan and the Picnic in Europe, SKF said.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
SKF said series production would begin immediately at its Airasca plant in Italy.
